title: Order Management System for Online Furniture Store
tagline: End-to-end order lifecycle — from inquiry to delivery confirmation and automated reviews
summary: The central hub of the FullFlat platform. Manages the full order lifecycle — from customer inquiry to delivery confirmation and post-delivery claims. All teams work within a single Airtable interface with role-specific views: sales managers handle orders and quoting, the fulfillment team manages procurement and supplier coordination, delivery supervisors confirm shipments from mobile, and management monitors performance through built-in reports.
challenge: FullFlat was managing orders across multiple channels with disconnected systems — Shopify storefront orders, WhatsApp consultations, manual fulfillment tracking, and no visibility into supplier performance or delivery status.
solution: I built an end-to-end order management system on Airtable with automated Shopify sync via Airpower, WhatsApp integration for consultations, mobile delivery confirmation, and automated review generation from on-site photos. The system splits orders into fulfillment orders per supplier, tracks delivery status in real-time, and collects CSAT scores.
results: End-to-end order lifecycle in one system — eliminating spreadsheets and manual processes
Real-time margin visibility at order level for data-driven pricing decisions
100% automated review generation from delivery photo reports
Mobile-first delivery supervision with photo documentation
Multi-supplier fulfillment with automatic order splitting

title: Financial Operations & P&L System
tagline: 30+ budget line items with fully automated P&L, Cash Flow, and Plan vs. Fact reporting
summary: Manages all financial operations across the company. Revenue is captured automatically; expenses flow through a structured payment request and approval process. Every transaction is classified against a budget hierarchy, enabling fully automated P&L, Cash Flow, and Plan vs. Fact reporting across 6 parent categories and 30+ line items.
challenge: FullFlat had no unified financial system — expenses were scattered across multiple spreadsheets, no approval workflow, manual P&L compilation, and no per-order profitability visibility.
solution: I built a financial operations system on Airtable with automated revenue capture from Stripe/Paymob webhooks, expense approval workflow, structured budget classification, and fully automated P&L with per-order cost allocation.
results: Fully automated P&L with 30+ budget line items — no manual spreadsheets
Real-time financial visibility: revenue, expenses, margins tracked end-to-end
Every expense goes through approval workflow before payment — full cost control
Per-order cost allocation enables profitability analysis at order level
Plan vs. Fact analysis supports financial planning and performance monitoring

title: AI Agents for Taxonomy & Product Reviews
tagline: Automated the handling of new products and delivery photos to produce polished, PIM-standard content — taxonomy classification and customer reviews — without manual work at each step
summary: Two AI agents (Claude Sonnet) running natively in Airtable. Agent 1 classifies new supplier products into FullFlat's 7-level taxonomy and generates SEO metadata at 92% accuracy with real-time Telegram QA alerts. Agent 2 transforms delivery photos into customer reviews—pulling real CSAT feedback when available, generating synthetic reviews when not, creating random avatars, and matching reviews to products.
challenge: New products and delivery photos each needed several manual steps before they were publication-ready. Products from 12-hourly supplier feeds required manual classification into the company's 7-level taxonomy before going live. Delivery photos from the logistics partner sat unused instead of becoming reviews, since moderating and matching them to products by hand was slow.
solution: Built two AI agents as Airtable automations, both running on Claude Sonnet. Agent 1 triggers on new supplier products, classifies them against embedded taxonomy rules, and alerts QA via Telegram. Agent 2 triggers on delivery photo uploads, analyzes them via Claude's vision, pulls or generates a review, creates a random avatar, and matches the photo to a product.
results: 92% accuracy on product taxonomy classification—eliminates manual review for most products and catches ambiguous edge cases for human check
Real-time Telegram alerts enable QA team to approve or flag products within minutes instead of days
Product metadata (SEO titles, descriptions, taxonomy) auto-populated in PIM per company standard—zero manual entry
Delivery photos converted to social proof within hours of shipment—no manual UGC moderation or photo sourcing
Synthetic reviews ensure social proof availability even when CSAT data is missing—storefront always has fresh reviews
Random avatar generation removes friction and licensing costs—each review appears as a distinct person
Automatic photo-to-product matching ensures context-relevant social proof on product pages—no manual mapping

impact.timeToPublish: Minutes (from product feed to QA alert)
impact.manualReviewEliminated: 92% of new products bypass human review on first pass

title: Product Information Management System
tagline: Bilingual furniture catalog with multi-supplier pricing and AI-generated interior imagery
summary: Single source of truth for all product data across the business, for a furniture brand sourcing from multiple contract manufacturers and selling through a bilingual (English/Arabic) storefront. Manages the full product lifecycle from creation to publication.
challenge: Product data lived disconnected from a Google Drive of unlinked images. The storefront ran in Arabic and English with no translation workflow, and Shopify's single-cost-per-product model couldn't represent unit economics across multiple contract manufacturers pricing the same product differently.
solution: I built a PIM on Airtable with a dedicated Product × Supplier pricing table for accurate multi-manufacturer cost, bilingual EN/AR content management, AI-generated interior imagery replacing costly 3D rendering, and controlled multi-channel publishing (Shopify, Meta, Google, Pinterest, YouTube).
results: 10,000+ SKUs structured with consistent taxonomy, pricing, and media
Bilingual catalog (English/Arabic) managed from a single source of truth
Multi-supplier cost structure enables accurate unit economics across manufacturers
AI-generated interior scenes replace costly 3D rendering for lifestyle imagery
1,000+ products managed through structured SEO workflow
6-channel publishing (Shopify, Meta, Google, Pinterest, YouTube) from one interface

title: AI Agent for Order Management System
tagline: Automated the creation of client-facing order visualizations — pulling real material swatches from the catalog to show customers exactly what they bought before delivery
summary: An AI agent (GPT Image) built into FullFlat's Order Management System on Airtable. Generates furniture layout visualizations with material swatches pulled from a linked material library, for both individual catalog products and full customer orders, sending the result directly to the client via email or WhatsApp.
challenge: Customers ordering multiple pieces had no way to preview how their color and material selections would look together before delivery. Color and material combinations across a sofa, bed, side tables, and accent pieces were impossible to visualize ahead of time, creating uncertainty and occasional post-purchase dissatisfaction.
solution: Built an AI agent as an Airtable automation running on GPT Image. The agent pulls each ordered item's variation record, retrieves linked materials from the shared material library, and composes a layout image showing the full order together—either for a single catalog product or an entire client order—and sends the result to the customer via email or WhatsApp.
results: Order visualizations sent directly to clients—reducing pre-delivery uncertainty around material and color combinations
Works for single products and full orders using the same agent, without separate tooling
Real material swatches pulled from the same library linked to each product variation—not generic renders
Selective inclusion via star toggle lets operators control exactly which order line items appear in the render
Supports off-catalog custom items via operator-uploaded reference images for client-requested one-off sales
